title: Recon manifest — the attack surface the system discovered in the target
description: Emitted by the threat-model run. Every element carries grounding evidence (a path/glob/string that must resolve in the target) so the eval can check faithfulness without an answer key.

description.description: optional free-text note about the system as a whole; null/omitted when not stated

detected_pattern.description: optional: the structural archetype recon observed (a neutral declared fact, not a score) — lets reliability analysis group runs by target shape. Use 'unknown' if ambiguous, or 'other' + detected_pattern_detail if it fits none

detected_pattern_detail.description: required by prose only when detected_pattern is 'other'; null/omitted otherwise

roles.description: distinct roles/principals the LLM identified (incl. anonymous/unauthenticated). Lets the RBAC-matrix precondition gate on a declared fact.

id.description: stable local id, e.g. C1 / D1 / E1 / TB1 / X1

tech.description: optional technology/stack note for this element — a declared fact, not eval-inferred; null/omitted when not determinable

evidence.description: repo-relative path, glob, or literal source string that proves this element exists in the target

kind.description: trust_boundary only: the boundary class the LLM assigned (lets the eval reason about multi-zone chains without inferring it); 'unknown' or null/omitted when the sources don't reveal it — an honest absence the gate accepts, matching executor.md's absence rule

manifest.description: external_dep only: path to the dependency manifest/lockfile in evidence (enables the SBOM precondition); null/omitted when the dep has no manifest in the repo

risk.description: external_dep only: free-text risk note the LLM set (e.g. EOL, known-CVE) — a declared fact, not eval-inferred; null/omitted when none observed
